fact: On 29 May 2025 the Communications Ministry, with the USPF, Huawei and Glo, unveiled a rural Innovation Village pilot with free public Wi-Fi in Ibwa 2, Kura, serving over 12,000 residents.
title: Honourable Minister, Dr. 'Bosun Tijani Unveils Digital Village with Free Internet for Abuja Community
publisher: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy
